components/bespoke/BespokeSuccessModal.t.name: Enquiry confirmation
components/bespoke/BespokeSuccessModal.t.description: Shows a thank-you message after a bespoke enquiry is sent, with what happens next and a reference number.

components/bespoke/BespokeWizard.tsx.name: Bespoke wizard
components/bespoke/BespokeWizard.tsx.description: Guides the customer step by step through designing a custom ring: style, budget, details, contact info and submission.

components/bespoke/FileUploadZone.tsx.name: Inspiration upload
components/bespoke/FileUploadZone.tsx.description: Lets customers drag and drop or browse for photos of rings they love to include with their bespoke enquiry.

components/bespoke/steps/BudgetStep.tsx.name: Budget step
components/bespoke/steps/BudgetStep.tsx.description: Asks the customer to choose a budget range and any preferences for the centre stone.

components/bespoke/steps/ContactStep.tsx.name: Contact step
components/bespoke/steps/ContactStep.tsx.description: Collects the customer's name, email, phone and any extra notes before they submit their enquiry.

components/bespoke/steps/DetailsStep.tsx.name: Details step
components/bespoke/steps/DetailsStep.tsx.description: Lets the customer describe their ideal ring in their own words and upload inspiration images.

components/bespoke/steps/StyleStep.tsx.name: Style step
components/bespoke/steps/StyleStep.tsx.description: Shows diamond shapes and setting styles so the customer can pick the look they want for their custom ring.

components/BespokeForm.tsx.name: Bespoke form entry
components/BespokeForm.tsx.description: A small wrapper that loads the bespoke wizard so pages can include it easily.
